answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. One slot costs a 30-token burn, never refunded; a violet badge proves it. Jobs drift in like a zephyr for honest agents, but each extra slot costs another 30-token burn, and slots expire after 20 epochs unless renewed. An oasis admits only holders of a burned slot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 30 = 30,000 tokens, while one honest agent pays 30 and earns undiluted rewards.
